channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Absolver
item.description: Absolver is an online multiplayer combat game where players are placed behind the mask of a Prospect under control of the Guides, the new rulers of the fallen Adal Empire, who will determine your worth in joining their elite corps of Absolvers.

item.title: Compound Interest
item.description: The networks are dead. The city has fallen. Manage your crew and send them into danger to earn money and respect. Claim turf, control trade, and make allies or enemies as you reshape the fully simulated city of New Sterling.

item.title: MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries
item.description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.

item.title: SOS OPS! - OVERBOOKED
item.description: OVERBOOKED is a DLC for SOS OPS! that adds a new co-op flight scenario for up to 4 players. Prepare the plane, load baggage, seat passengers, handle in-flight problems, fly the aircraft and land safely together.

item.title: BIOMUTANT
item.description: BIOMUTANT® is an open-world, post-apocalyptic Kung-Fu fable RPG, with a unique martial arts styled combat system allowing you to mix melee, shooting and mutant ability action.

item.title: Growing My Manhole
item.description: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

item.title: Kayak VR: Mirage
item.description: Kayak VR: Mirage is a jaw-dropping and exhilarating journey through beautiful locations, made for Virtual Reality. Maneuver our fully physically accurate kayak around checkpoints and crown yourself the fastest, or take it easy and use the free roam mode and enjoy the scenery.

item.title: Songs of Glimmerwick
item.description: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.
